aim_1.title: Develop and Validate an Integrated Exposure Index (IEI)
aim_1.description: Create a weighted composite exposure metric integrating outdoor exposures (residential proximity to highways and industrial zones; ambient PM2.5, PM10, O3, SO2 from TCEQ/EPA stations) with indoor household exposures from BREATHE-CC surveys (secondhand smoke, gas cooking, mold/dampness, ventilation quality, pet allergens). Time-weighted across exposure locations using percentage-of-time variables. Validated through sensitivity analyses (varying weighting schemes, spatial interpolation methods) and comparison against single-pollutant models.

aim_2.title: Test IEI Associations with Pediatric Asthma Outcomes
aim_2.description: Using available BREATHE-CC data, examine the IEI's independent associations with (a) monthly asthma exacerbation frequency, (b) Childhood Asthma Control Test (C-ACT) scores, and (c) wheezing phenotype trajectories identified via Group-Based Trajectory Modeling. Models adjust for sociodemographic covariates. Analysis pipeline built as a reproducible, documented codebase so it can be rerun on the full BREATHE-CC cohort once data collection is finalized. This aim produces a reproducible framework for later completion, not necessarily final data.

aims.scope_note: An earlier version included a Neighborhood Completeness Index (NCI). Scope was refined to focus on the IEI in depth. The NCI remains viable future work.

key_external_dependencies.breathecc_data_status: Cohort actively enrolling. Data collection ongoing. Final dataset NOT available by thesis defense. All analyses use available data with pipeline designed for rerunning on finalized cohort.
key_external_dependencies.irb_modification_needed: Time-Activity Supplement instrument requires IRB modification. Address collection (school, secondary residence) are HIPAA identifiers. Estimated 2-6 week turnaround depending on whether consent addendum is required.
key_external_dependencies.spanish_translation: Required for bilingual cohort. Must be submitted alongside English version to IRB.
